title: Computers and the internet
kind: 对话 · 珍妮和妈妈聊电脑与互联网给学习带来的变化

timeline.text: Jenny wants to do her homework on the computer. But her mum is using it.
Mum, is it okay if I use the computer now?
Okay. I just finished my work, so it’s all yours. Jenny, you’re so lucky to have a computer.
Yes, I am. As it’s connected to the internet, it has made study and research much easier.
This technology helps students a lot with their homework. But when I was a student, computers were not widely used. And the internet was not as convenient as it is now.
I couldn’t imagine having such a convenient tool for getting the job done.
Mum, how was homework done in those days?
Well, everything was written by hand on paper. When I didn’t know how to spell a word, I had to look it up in a printed dictionary.
When I needed to do any research, I had to go to the library.
But now with the internet we can simply search for everything online. And there’s always new technology, like AI.
Yes, and you can easily find definitions and examples for any word. The internet and the computer are amazing inventions with many applications.
I agree with you on that, Mum.
